tasks.instruction: You've just heard about Astro from a friend who mentioned they use it to watch sports and local dramas. You decide to check it out for the first time. Look around this page. When you're ready, tell us: what do you understand about what Astro offers? Is there anything you'd want to do or look at next — and why?
tasks.response:
Okay so my friend said Astro got sports and drama kan — this page actually shows it straight away. 'Endless streaming with Astro One' — so it's like a streaming thing. The main pack they're pushing is Entertainment Zero, RM49.99 a month. No box required, cancel anytime. That bit is good lah, I don't want to sign a contract.

But wait — there's a 'No contract' and 'Smart saver 12+ month plan' toggle at the top. I clicked no contract. RM49.99 is a bit steep when I'm already paying for Netflix. But okay, no contract means I can try and cancel if it's rubbish.

The content thumbnails — I can see some shows but I can't really tell if there's football here. It says 'Entertainment Zero' but where's the sports? My friend specifically said sports. There's no mention of sports on this main recommended card. That's weird.

Oh there's a 'Compare all packs' link. I'd click that — I want to see if there's a sports pack specifically before I go any further. The 'Three easy steps' thing is nice, straightforward. Choose pack, confirm ID, stream. That I understand.

WhatsApp us button — yeah I might use that if I can't find the sports info. But I'd try compare all packs first.

Next action: Click 'Compare all packs'. I want to find out if there's a specific sports option and what it costs. Right now this page is pushing me toward Entertainment Zero but it doesn't answer my sports question.

eval.confusion_signal: Missing sports content signal on homepage — primary reason user came is not immediately visible on recommended card
eval.trust_signal: No contract / cancel anytime messaging landed well. Three easy steps clear.
eval.value_proposition_clarity: vague — understood it's streaming but couldn't connect to personal interest (sports)
eval.visual_hierarchy_effectiveness: off-target — Entertainment Zero is prominent but sports is not surfaced for this persona
eval.information_gaps: Where is sports content? What channels are included? Can I pay by e-wallet?

tasks.instruction: You're looking for a TV subscription for your household. You watch a mix of sports, movies, and local content. Browse through what's available here. Tell us what stands out, what's confusing, and what — if anything — would make you want to take action. If nothing appeals to you, explain what's missing or holding you back.
tasks.response:
Okay now I can see the packs properly. Three options: Entertainment 12 at RM39.99, Sports 12 at RM69.99, Epic 24 at RM159.99.

Sports 12 — this is what I was looking for. RM69.99 a month. But hold on — 12 month contract. Billed monthly but it's a 12-month commitment. That's not the same as cancel anytime from the homepage. So the 'no contract' I saw earlier — that was only for Entertainment Zero? I'm confused which packs are no-contract and which require commitment.

RM69.99 for sports. I'm getting football for free on Sooka right now. The ads are annoying but I'm not going to pay RM70 to avoid ads lah. That's too much. And I don't even know if Sooka sports rights continue — so why would I pay RM70 for the same thing via Astro?

Entertainment 12 at RM39.99 — cheaper. But it says 'Best of content' and I can see some channels listed but I can't see clearly if there's local drama or football. It just says 'Base | View more'. I'd want to click 'View more' to see the actual channel list before deciding.

Epic 24 at RM159.99 — no way. 24 months, that's two years, and RM160 a month? I have Netflix for much less. Hard pass.

What would make me convert: If Sports 12 had a no-contract option at maybe RM40-45 I'd consider it. Right now the price-to-commitment ratio doesn't work for me. I'd probably just stick with free Sooka and deal with the ads.

Also — where do I pay? Is e-wallet available? Nothing on this page tells me how to actually pay. That matters.

eval.confusion_signal: No-contract vs 12-month contract distinction unclear — homepage implied no-contract but pack page shows commitments. Pack number naming (12, 24) not immediately intuitive.
eval.abandon_trigger: Price-to-commitment ratio on Sports 12. RM69.99 vs current free Sooka alternative. No e-wallet payment signal.
eval.trust_signal: negative — felt misled by homepage no-contract messaging vs pack page contract requirement
eval.pack_differentiation_clarity: blurry — could tell packs apart by price but not by content depth without clicking View more
eval.personal_relevance: uncertain — Sports 12 relevant in category but not in price/contract terms

session_summary: Hakim understood the product category quickly and found sports content eventually, but the price-commitment mismatch on Sports 12 vs his free Sooka alternative killed intent. The no-contract messaging on the homepage created false expectations that the pack page then contradicted. No e-wallet payment signal was a secondary concern. Would not convert at current pricing.
h1_verdict: falsified — could not distinguish pack value clearly enough to select without the View more detail, and price was a blocker before pack differentiation mattered
